# Audio tools

6 tools. Not registered under `GODOT_MCP_PROFILE=core`; ask for it by name with `GODOT_MCP_CATEGORIES=audio`.

[← All categories](README.md)

## `add_audio_player`

Add an AudioStreamPlayer, AudioStreamPlayer2D, or AudioStreamPlayer3D node to the scene. The node plays audio on the specified bus. Call load_audio_file to assign a stream afterward.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `parent_path` | `string` | — | Path to parent node (default: scene root) |
| `node_name` | `string` | — | Name for the new node (default: 'AudioStreamPlayer', 'AudioStreamPlayer2D', or 'AudioStreamPlayer3D') |
| `type` | `string` | — | 'flat' (default) — no spatial audio. '2d' — attenuates with distance in 2D. '3d' — full 3D spatial audio. One of: `"flat"`, `"2d"`, `"3d"`. |
| `bus` | `string` | — | Name of the audio bus to play on (default: 'Master') |
| `volume_db` | `number` | — | Volume in decibels (default: 0.0). Negative values are quieter, 0 is original. |
| `pitch_scale` | `number` | — | Pitch multiplier (default: 1.0). 2.0 = one octave up, 0.5 = one octave down. |
| `autoplay` | `boolean` | — | Start playing automatically when the scene starts (default: false) |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/14-audio.json`, test AU-01:

```json
{
  "parent_path": ".",
  "node_name": "Player",
  "type": "2d"
}
```

## `load_audio_file`

Assign an audio stream resource to an AudioStreamPlayer node. The file must already exist in the Godot project. Supports .ogg, .wav, and .mp3 files.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `node_path` | `string` | yes | Path to the AudioStreamPlayer, AudioStreamPlayer2D, or AudioStreamPlayer3D node |
| `file_path` | `string` | yes | Project-relative path to the audio file, e.g. 'res://audio/music.ogg' |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/14-audio.json`, test AU-05:

```json
{
  "node_path": "Player",
  "file_path": "res://nonexistent.ogg"
}
```

## `play_audio`

Start playback on an AudioStreamPlayer node. Works in the editor — audio will be audible if the node has a stream assigned. Fully undoable.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `node_path` | `string` | yes | Path to the AudioStreamPlayer node |
| `from_position` | `number` | — | Position in the stream to start from, in seconds (default: 0.0) |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/14-audio.json`, test AU-06:

```json
{
  "node_path": "Player"
}
```

## `stop_audio`

Stop playback on an AudioStreamPlayer node. If the node was playing, undo will restart playback from the beginning. Fully undoable.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `node_path` | `string` | yes | Path to the AudioStreamPlayer node |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/14-audio.json`, test AU-07:

```json
{
  "node_path": "Player"
}
```

## `configure_bus`

Set volume, mute, solo, or send routing on an audio bus. At least one of volume_db, mute, solo, or send must be provided. Changes apply to the AudioServer immediately and are undoable. The 'Master' bus always exists and cannot have its send rerouted; other buses must be created in the Audio panel first.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `bus_name` | `string` | yes | Name of the audio bus to configure (e.g. 'Master', 'Music', 'SFX') |
| `volume_db` | `number` | — | New volume in decibels for this bus (0.0 = unity gain, -80 = silent) |
| `mute` | `boolean` | — | Mute or unmute this bus |
| `solo` | `boolean` | — | Solo this bus (silences all other non-soloed buses) |
| `send` | `string` | — | Name of the bus to route this bus's output to (e.g. 'Master'). Only valid for non-Master buses. |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/14-audio.json`, test AU-02:

```json
{
  "bus_name": "Master",
  "volume_db": -6
}
```

## `add_audio_effect`

Add an audio effect (reverb, compressor, EQ, etc.) to an audio bus. Effects are applied in order. Fully undoable.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `bus_name` | `string` | yes | Name of the audio bus to add the effect to (e.g. 'Master', 'Music') |
| `effect_type` | `string` | yes | Type of effect to add. 'reverb' — room echo. 'compressor' — dynamic range compression. 'eq6'/'eq10' — equalizer. 'limiter' — peak prevention. 'amplify' — volume boost/cut. 'panner' — stereo pan. 'highpass'/'lowpass' — frequency filters. One of: `"reverb"`, `"distortion"`, `"eq6"`, `"eq10"`, `"chorus"`, `"delay"`, `"compressor"`, `"limiter"`, `"amplify"`, `"panner"`, `"highpass"`, `"lowpass"`. |
| `effect_name` | `string` | — | Optional display name for the effect in the AudioServer panel |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/14-audio.json`, test AU-03:

```json
{
  "bus_name": "Master",
  "effect_type": "reverb",
  "effect_name": "TestReverb"
}
```
